source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Use refrigerated deli meats without reheating because refrigeration alone is considered sufficient to control foodborne risk in a weakened immune system.","B":"Choose pasteurized dairy and washed produce, but include undercooked eggs when the shells are intact and the eggs have remained refrigerated.","C":"Choose fully cooked meat and eggs, but include raw sprouts after thorough rinsing because washing is considered adequate for this higher-risk food.","D":"Choose fully cooked meat and eggs, pasteurized dairy, and washed produce, and heat deli meats until steaming hot or 165°F before serving them."}}
source_row.rationale: People with weakened immune systems have greater risk from foodborne illness. Option D is correct because CDC identifies thoroughly cooked meat and eggs, pasteurized dairy, washed produce, and reheated deli meats as safer choices. Option A is incorrect because unheated deli meats are a higher-risk choice. Option B is incorrect because undercooked eggs remain higher risk. Option C is incorrect because raw sprouts remain a higher-risk choice even after rinsing.
source_row.source_detail: CDC — Safer Food Choices for People With Weakened Immune Systems: choose pasteurized products and thoroughly cooked meat/eggs, wash produce, avoid raw sprouts and other higher-risk foods, and heat deli meats/hot dogs until steaming hot or 165°F when recommended for people with weakened immune systems. Current CDC food-safety guidance for people with weakened immune systems; live federal source rechecked 2026-08-15. Blueprint corrected from Basic Care and Comfort to Safety & Infection Prevention and Control because the tested objective is prevention of foodborne infection in a highly susceptible client. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Safe and Effective Care Environment — Safety and Infection Prevention and Control: patient identification, specimen collection, asepsis, high-alert medication safeguards, fall prevention and communication that prevents safety events as applicable. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.

source_row.stem: A client with a markedly weakened immune system asks how to reduce foodborne-infection risk at home. Which instruction is most appropriate?
